description: This PHP class 'FilterForm' is part of the Goteo project and extends 'AbstractFormProcessor' to build and process a complex form for filtering data based on various criteria such as roles, dates, projects, social commitments, status, and more. It includes methods for creating the form structure, retrieving choices for dropdowns, and saving the form data into a model.

classes.name: FilterForm
classes.description: A form processor class for constructing and handling filter forms in the Goteo application, allowing users to specify various filtering criteria related to projects, dates, social commitments, statuses, donors, locations, and other custom filters.

methods.name: createForm
methods.description: Initializes the form structure with various input fields including text, choice, date, location, and boolean types, and returns the form builder object.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and processes the submitted form data, updates the associated model with the filter criteria, and attempts to persist the data. Throws exceptions if validation fails or saving encounters errors.
